requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The Out-Of-Box Experience (OOBE) should minimize the number of product reference names displayed to the customer on 123.hp.com, consolidating all OfficeJet Pro 9010 variants into a single, clear reference.

requirements.Requirement: Printer able to run all new/current EM / market segment media
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer must reliably print on all new and current EM (Evaluation Media) and market segment media types, meeting the intervention rate specification for each region and climatic condition on the Manhattan platform.

requirements.Requirement: Product can be placed and work on uneven surface ( sofa , table cloth , carpet …)
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The product must function correctly without hardware failure when placed and operated on uneven surfaces such as sofas, table cloths, or carpets.

requirements.Requirement: Tilt left and right each while printing
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The requirement requests evaluation of printer functionality when tilted 20 degrees left or right during printing. However, the scope and necessity for the Marconi platform is unclear and appears to be marked for removal.
requirements.Reason_for_Ambiguity: Scope for Marconi platform is unclear; requirement is proposed to be dropped.

requirements.Requirement: Put printer on trolley and print
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer must print reliably without print quality issues when placed on a moving trolley.
